title: Flash floods in KL | FMT
text: Flash floods in KL | FMT Latest Headlines Newsletter Newsletter Sign In Flash floods in KL KUALA LUMPUR: Heavy rain which fell at about 6pm in the federal capital today caused flash floods at three major stretches. Kuala Lumpur Fire and Rescue operation chief Samsol Maarif Saibani said the roads affected by the floods were Jalan Raja Chulan, Jalan Kelapa Muda and Jalan Duta. “Heavy rain which started in the late afternoon caused flooding on the roads with water up to a metre deep,” he added. He said so far, the traffic situation in the affected areas was still under control. We have stationed 24 fire and rescue personnel for any possibilities, he added. – BERNAMA Stay current - Follow FMT on WhatsApp, Google news and Telegram WhatsApp Google News Telegram Subscribe to our newsletter and get news delivered to your mailbox.
